equipment.model: CryoAdvance 100 closed-cycle optical cryostat (optional OneK-Optic module)
equipment.family: closed-cycle optical cryostat (2-4 K, sub-K add-on)
equipment.description: Fully automated, sample-in-vacuum, cryogen-free optical cryostat with a 100 mm x 116 mm sample chamber, five windows, standard 4 RF (20 GHz) + 25 DC I/O, <15 nm vibration; used for quantum-dot single-photon sources, colour centres and photonic devices. The OneK-Optic add-on module extends the platform to <1.2 K (rare-earth / spin-photon work).

notes: 8 configurations from 4 manufacturers (Montana Instruments, ID Quantique, Quantum Design Oxford, ESPEC). Web search and Tavily quotas were exhausted early in this run, so sources are manufacturer PDFs and pages reached directly; PDF quotes come from text extracted from the fetched PDFs, and table rows that wrap across lines are joined with single spaces. Single stated operating temperatures (SNSPD detector base temperatures, OneK-Optic 1.2 K) are stored as lo = hi at the conservative bound. Absences use install=not_available (or optional_not_installed for an unfitted family option) with value kind unknown/flag; cryogen-free machines carry cryogen.type as the empty set. SNSPD systems have factory-installed detectors and no user sample space, so their sample size keys are in not_found; their optical access is fibre-only (recorded as optical_access=true with that caveat in the claim). ESPEC TSE-12-A temperature.range spans its two exposure zones (-65..0 C and +60..+200 C) with no dwell set point in between. The TSE-12-A optical_access absence rests on the catalog marking the viewing window as a TSD-101-W option; the magnet absences of SNSPD systems and climatic chambers rest on their complete specification tables. Candidates not used for lack of complete datasheets: Single Quantum Eos (brochure states only 2.5 K, closed cycle, fibre or free-space window), Ricor K508 (cooler only; dewar properties not specified), inTEST ThermoStream (datasheets behind a request form).
